description: Two `< machine>` declarations share the name `Signal`. Per §51.3 a machine name is unique within its file, so the duplicate is rejected with E-ENGINE-003 (§34: Error). Asserts the LEGACY-keyword duplicate path specifically — the `<engine>` form is covered by E-ENGINE-VAR-DUPLICATE.
rationale: §51.3 — a `< machine name=N>` declaration names a machine within the file; two declarations sharing a name are ambiguous (a write to the governed reactive could not resolve which rule set governs it). E-ENGINE-003 is the LEGACY `<machine>`-keyword duplicate code; the canonical `<engine>` form uses §51.0.C E-ENGINE-VAR-DUPLICATE instead, so exactly one duplicate code fires per declaration form.
